text_simplified: Parents must teach their children Salah and adherence to the Din, and avoid neglecting them or leaving them without guidance. Children need a good example and tarbiyah (upbringing) based on love and firmness. Keeping children away from bad companions and places of idle distraction helps in their righteous upbringing.
